fields.description: Keys are environment-bound: a Sandbox key does not work against Production.
fields.label: Environment

fields.description: Issued from the Pemo app. Stored encrypted; never sent to the browser.
fields.label: API Key

fields.description: Pemo receipt links expire about 30 minutes after a fetch, so receipts are saved as private files during the fetch and copied onto each Journal Entry.
fields.label: Download Receipts

fields.description: Skip topUp / walletTransfer / subWalletTransfer. Wallet funding is already booked from the bank side (e.g. BOB OD -> PEMO - DS); importing it too would double count.
fields.label: Skip Wallet Funding Movements

fields.description: The asset account the Pemo wallet sits in. Credited for spend, debited for refunds.
fields.label: Pemo Wallet Account

fields.description: Used when a row has no Project, or its Project has no Cost Center. Falls back to the Company's default.
fields.label: Default Cost Center

fields.description: Recoverable input VAT, debited when a row is VAT Applicable = Yes.
fields.label: Input VAT Account

fields.description: Used to back the VAT out of the VAT-inclusive Pemo amount.
fields.label: VAT Rate

fields.description: Draft workflow state new Journal Entries are moved into, so they appear for approval. Leave blank to keep them in Draft. Must be a draft (docstatus 0) state of the active Journal Entry workflow.
fields.label: Journal Entry Workflow State
